class.name: OpenWorldPlacement3D
class.brief_description: Applies deterministic mixed procedural placements with optional SimpleTerrain3D surface projection.
class.description: An apply operation removes only managed placements whose anchors are inside the preset footprint, then creates replacement Tree, Bramble, and Rock records and scene nodes. Surviving managed placements outside the footprint participate in minimum-spacing rejection. Generated nodes are derived from [member placement_data]. [member terrain_path] is optional. When unset (or unresolved), candidates are placed on a flat horizontal plane at the apply center height with upward normals.

method.name: apply_placement
method.description: Transactionally replaces managed placements in the projected footprint. Seed 0 uses [member default_seed].

method.name: clear_generated
method.description: Deletes owned generated nodes without deleting placement records.

method.name: clear_placements
method.description: Deletes owned generated nodes and placement records.

method.name: preview_placement
method.description: Solves candidates and replacement counts without mutating scene or placement data.

method.name: rebuild_generated
method.description: Recreates all owned generated nodes from placement records.

members.member: Optional output parent. An empty path uses this node.
Optional [SimpleTerrain3D] used for surface projection. Empty path places on a flat plane.
